title: ABB Q2 2026 results
excerpt: Q2 orders were USD 12.042 billion, revenue USD 9.475 billion and operational EBITA margin 20.2%; first-half basic EPS was USD 1.41.
summary: The hash-identical issuer Q2 results preserve the orders, revenue, margins, cash conversion, net debt, earnings, Robotics proceeds and proposed Rotork acquisition evidence used in the refreshed scenario review.
